snippet.title: Kai Cenat Finally Plays GTA 6: "We Waited 13 Years" #gta6
snippet.description:
GTA 6 launch day: before booting the game live, Kai Cenat remembers being a kid who couldn't get GTA 5 and had to watch TheRadBrad and VanossGaming play it instead. "Chat, we waited 13 years, bro." Then the game starts, and his first GTA 6 gameplay: the boat ride ("it looks so good") and the seaplane take-off.

Clip from Kai Cenat's GTA 6 launch stream (Kai Cenat Live, November 18, 2026)
Game footage: Grand Theft Auto VI, Grand Theft Auto V trailers (Rockstar Games)
Music: "Better Times Are Coming" – Mixkit

snippet.title: Kai Cenat Beat GTA 6 in 67 Hours and Still Wouldn't Give It a 9 | GTA 6
snippet.description:
Follow for daily gaming drama 🔔

Kai Cenat finished GTA 6 with 67 hours on his stream clock (67:16 on screen), tearing up at the ending ("Oh my god, bro"). Then the verdict: "It's not as funny or playful as GTA 5, but the realism is what kills every other game." Final score: "I would rate this game 8.8." / "It's right at the nine mark."

No ending spoilers shown: only Kai's facecam from the finale.

Clips: Kai Cenat's live stream, as posted on X by @yoxics (https://x.com/yoxics/status/2124058268805059062, https://x.com/yoxics/status/2124055376157127001) and @scubaryan_ (https://x.com/scubaryan_/status/2124058103444332762). Commentary and edit by milkman69.

8.8 or a 10? What's your score? 👇
